summary: Part 3 (04:45 to 04:51) of "12.0 South Africa Bulk Shipments (Seller & KAMs)" contains no training content. It is a closing title card: the Revibe logo on a purple gradient, the green pill "Questions? Message your Revibe account manager." and "Thank you!". The only spoken line in this window is "Thank you." at 04:47. No steps, apps, pages, rules or numbers are shown in this part.

facts.statement: If you have questions, message your Revibe account manager.

evidence.quote: Green pill with text 'Questions? Message your Revibe account manager.' above 'Thank you!' on the closing card; the same text appears in a dark caption bar at the bottom.

screens.name: Closing title card
screens.shows: Revibe logo on a purple gradient, the green pill 'Questions? Message your Revibe account manager.', the text 'Thank you!', and a bottom caption bar with the same question. t00285 shows the logo and the bottom caption bar only; the green pill and 'Thank you!' are not yet visible. t00290 shows the logo, the green pill and 'Thank you!' without the bottom caption bar.
